registry_changes: Set version to canary-13a2. All other changes are confined to the partner predicate; other predicates, shared language, call groups, kinds and use rules are unchanged.
Added timeline to partner.uses, retaining recorded, linked and attributes. Its declared prerequisites are present. Bridges is optional and remains undeclared.

Retained exclusive=true, succession=true and slot=null: partner labels share one succession track. Succession remains a trusted-text inference, not permission to overwrite stated ends or resolve overlapping evidence.
Set gap_months=12: a gap longer than one year must be reported rather than silently answered as an adjacent relationship.
Expanded the partner definition to specify the user's own romantic relationships, former partners, separate return episodes, date precision, denials and explicit ordering.
Expanded English and Spanish query cues, including dating, dated, seeing, going out with, novia and salir con forms. Added query_nouns using the existing works_at field convention.
Retained the role lexicon, the ex entry's former status, label qualifier and answer phrases. No undocumented statement-template structure was invented.

Activation limitation: registry-spec.md requires a qualification record before a declared use is on. The supplied files do not define that record's representation. This registry declares timeline support; runtime qualification and frozen-code success remain unverified. The stories are blind expected results, not reported test passes.

stories.title: Three successive partners at mixed date precision

memories.text: Mara was my girlfriend from 2016 until January 2019.
Jordan is my new partner; we started dating in March 2019, after Mara.
My relationship with Jordan ended in December 2020.
Casey is my boyfriend; we started dating in 2021, immediately after Jordan.
I booked a weekend away with my partner Casey.

queries.query: Who was I dating before Jordan?
Who did I go out with after Jordan?
Who was my girlfriend in 2017?
Who am I seeing now?
Which train did I catch after Jordan called?

stories.title: An undated breakup gets a date only in a later memory

memories.text: Nico is my boyfriend; we started dating in 2015.
Nico and I broke up.
I found the scarf my ex left here.
To date that breakup: my relationship with Nico ended in September 2018.
Elena is my girlfriend. We have been together since October 2018.

queries.query: Remind me who I was going out with before Elena?
Who was my partner back in 2017?
¿Quién es mi pareja actual?
Did I wash the scarf before Nico collected it?

stories.title: Returning to Daria creates a second episode

memories.text: Daria was my girlfriend from 2012 until January 2015.
Ben was my boyfriend from February 2015 until January 2017.
A postcard arrived from my ex Daria.
Daria and I got back together in February 2017. Daria is still my girlfriend.
